title: Play the engine
subtitle: Choose a level, pick your colour and play a full game against Stockfish. Your moves get immediate feedback without interrupting the game unless there is something worth retrying.

setup.eloNote: The Elo labels are an approximate playing-strength guide. Lower levels deliberately choose weaker Stockfish candidate lines.

coach.setup: I am Stockfish. Choose the strength and colour you want, then we will play a real game.
coach.reading: I am reading the position before your turn. One moment.
coach.yourTurn: Your turn. Play the position as you would in a normal game.
coach.thinking: My turn. I am calculating my reply.
coach.engineMove: I played {{move}}. The position is yours again.
coach.engineError: I could not finish that calculation. You can restart the game from the setup.
coach.intro: Ready. You are playing against my approximate {{elo}} level.
coach.checking: You played {{move}}. I am checking what changed in the position.
coach.retry: Good. We have returned to the position before your move. Try another idea.

quality.best: {{move}} is the best move I found. Excellent reading of the position.
quality.excellent: {{move}} is excellent. It keeps almost all of the position's potential.
quality.okay: {{move}} is playable. There may be a more precise option, but the position remains healthy.
quality.inaccuracy: {{move}} is a small inaccuracy. Nothing catastrophic, but you gave away part of the position.
quality.mistake: {{move}} is a mistake. I have a concrete reply now; the red arrow shows the main threat.
quality.blunder: {{move}} is a serious blunder. The red arrow shows the tactical reply you have allowed.

end.win: Game over. You beat Stockfish at this level. Nice work.
end.loss: Game over. I won this one, but the full review can show exactly where the game changed.
end.draw: Game over. Draw. The review can still reveal the critical moments.

game.title: Game
game.noMoves: The moves will appear here as the game progresses.

win.title: Victory
win.body: You defeated Stockfish {{elo}}. You can analyse the complete PGN now or play another game.

loss.title: Stockfish wins
loss.body: Stockfish {{elo}} won this game. Analyse the PGN to find the decisive moments, or play again immediately.

draw.title: Draw
draw.body: You drew with Stockfish {{elo}}. The complete PGN is ready if you want to review the game.

end.analysing: Analysing the complete PGN with your NexoChess review settings…
end.analysisError: The game could not be analysed. You can try again or keep reviewing the moves here.
